description: This class defines a Java entity for product option values in a catalog, extending another base class and implementing Serializable for object serialization.

classes.name: ProductOptionValueEntity
classes.description: A Java class representing a product option value with additional properties 'order' and 'code'.

methods.name: setOrder
methods.description: Sets the order of the product option value.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Returns the order of the product option value.

methods.name: setCode
methods.description: Sets the code associated with the product option value.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the code of the product option value.
